title: Laura Loomer Gets a Pass For Her Racism as the Media Continues to Bash Hasan Piker Instead
author: Martin Pengelly
content:
_On this day in 2015, President Barack Obama renamed America 's tallest peak
in Alaska as Denali, its Native American name. In 2025, Donald Trump ordered
the name changed back to Mt. McKinley, after the assassinated 25th president -
another lover of tariffs._

Good morning, and [Happy Monday](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1CeEvwvB-rQ)
as ever. **Martin** here, delighted to kick off your week. Please note that
this week's Madchester musical link is to the video for "Stinkin Thinkin," a
quality which might be said to apply to many of our subjects today.

First in **' First Draft,'** we'll take a look at the wholly absurd situation
in which far-right provocateur and close Trump adviser **Laura Loomer** can
abuse five prominent Black Democratic women in viciously racist terms, to
absolute crickets from the media and Democratic establishment, leaving the
strongest condemnation to no less than **Marjorie Taylor Greene**. Of course,
our press and pols are busy, what with so many attacks to be mounted on
**Hasan Piker** instead. Then we'll turn to **Donald Trump** himself, and his
hissy fit about **Kristen Welker** of NBC correctly saying he has had "some
mixed results" with endorsements of late. There are also worrying developments
to consider in Trump's forever war with Iran, with missiles flying over the
Strait of Hormuz once again.

We're also happy to say that this week, **' First Draft'** will be published
without a paywall, so new readers can see what **Zeteo** brings to your table
each weekday morning: reporting and opinion on all the news you need, on the
political subjects that matter. Let's get to it.

# 'Who You Calling a Bitch?'

[![](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!Qi55!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-
post-
media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fcc75cc10-fe2b-4189-8bcc-79b85302502e_7008x4672.jpeg)](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!Qi55!,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-
post-
media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fcc75cc10-fe2b-4189-8bcc-79b85302502e_7008x4672.jpeg)_Far-
right activist Laura Loomer. Photo by Jacob M. Langston/The Washington Post
via Getty Images_

On Friday, the far-right activist and close Trump ally and adviser Laura
Loomer treated the world to some foul racist invective, calling prominent
Democrats Rep. Ilhan Omar, Rep. Ayanna Pressley, former Rep. Cori Bush,
Supreme Court Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson, and Florida Senate candidate
Angie Nixon **" ghetto Black bitches."**

Loomer said she didn't care about being called racist, but she did seem to
care when one target answered back.

**" Girl," **Nixon
[posted](https://x.com/AngieNixon/status/2093532938885271820?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw%7Ctwcamp%5Etweetembed%7Ctwterm%5E2093532938885271820%7Ctwgr%5Ed3e882ebb8a657d3efb90a4a19f2c9cc64366651%7Ctwcon%5Es1_&ref_url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.huffpost.com%2Fentry%2Fangie-
nixon-laura-loomer-racist-rant_n_6a9270e5e4b0b47f3d0c4fc6), before reaching,
effectively, for the campaign vernacular of our times. (See Abdul El-Sayed's
[baiting of "beta" opponent Mike Rogers](https://zeteo.com/p/abdul-el-sayed-
went-on-fox-and-cut).)

**" You ate dog food on camera**," Nixon wrote, about something Loomer
definitely [did](https://www.yahoo.com/news/inside-pro-maga-pet-
company-204305398.html)**. "In the words of Queen Latifah, 'Who you calling a
bitch?'**

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Loomer [responded](https://x.com/LauraLoomer/status/2093557105299210336) with
more gutter racism: **' I called you a ghetto bitch, because you are, Angie,
and your record proves it. But, you speak Ebonics though, so maybe I need to
bark at you and tug your leash and then you'll finally understand."**

On Sunday, Nixon hit back,
[writing](https://x.com/AngieNixon/status/2094008081231257894): **" When
referring to me, it's [State] Representative Angie Nixon. However after
November 3rd, YOU CAN CALL ME SENATOR!"**

Loomer [wrote](https://x.com/LauraLoomer/status/2094058628559065508): **"
Ok[ay] Shaniqua."**

Enter an unlikely defender. Marjorie Taylor Greene, the QAnon-spouting former
MAGA congresswoman from Georgia with [plenty of racism in her own
record](https://www.politico.com/news/2020/06/17/house-republicans-condemn-
gop-candidate-racist-videos-325579), took Loomer to task.

**" I'm not a Democrat and I'm not supporting Angie Nixon, but the Republican
Party and President Trump owns Laura Loomer and her nonstop vitriol," **Greene
[wrote](https://x.com/FmrRepMTG/status/2094086034665374165?s=46). **" This
hateful, racists [sic], and demeaning rhetoric should not be tolerated. Ever.
But they allow it and keep her in the inner circle."**

The Piss Artist Commonly Known as MTG went on to say Loomer's racism would
hurt Senator Ashley Moody, the Republican who will face Nixon in November,
just as Loomer's influence over Donald Trump has damaged the party already.
Sticking to her current, politically convenient line of Trump apostasy, Greene
said Republicans could win on **" actual accomplishments for your voters and
policy plans that will help Americans."** Good luck with that. But then she
went back to safer ground, pointing to Loomer's own
[failed](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/gop-rep-dan-webster-narrowly-
beats-far-right-activist-laura-loomer-in-florida) congressional runs: **"
Voters proved twice that they reject her completely. When will the President
and the Republican Party reject her and her hateful racists [sic] behavior?
They refuse to[,] which tells you everything you need to know."**

Loomer went into overdrive, repeating her slur and using others,
[whining](https://x.com/LauraLoomer/status/2094102372985561229): **" Why is
anti-white racism ok[ay] but I'm not allowed to call a spade a spade."**

You had to say, MTG had a point. And so, turning to the press, [did
](https://x.com/mehdirhasan/status/2093912076339327188)**[Mehdi](https://x.com/mehdirhasan/status/2093912076339327188)**
:

> _**" Serious question to every mainstream news network and newspaper in this
> country: how can you justify crazy obsessive coverage of Hasan Piker and
> just totally ignore much worse stuff like this from an actual presidential
> adviser?"**_

Loomer may not have an official title, and may have denied working for Trump
in her exchange with Greene, but she very definitely is a close Trump adviser,
having last year [played a central
role](https://www.nytimes.com/2025/04/03/us/politics/trump-meeting-laura-
loomer.html) in his firing of six members of the National Security Council.
Responding to the _New York Times_ about that story, Trump denied it but also
called Loomer a **" great patriot**." This June, _Times_ reporters Maggie
Haberman and Jonathan Swan provided a five-page account of the meeting that
led to the firings. Their [bestselling book, ](https://zeteo.com/p/regime-
change-trump-haberman-swan)_[Regime Change](https://zeteo.com/p/regime-change-
trump-haberman-swan)_ , also includes another description of Loomer's White
House access, lunching and plotting with then-Attorney General Pam Bondi in
the West Wing.

Loomer has more on her CV. She recently went after a transgender CIA officer
in the White House intelligence directorate, who was soon
[removed](https://www.advocate.com/politics/national/racist-laura-loomer-
angie-nixon). She has taken credit for the swift deportation last week of Milo
Yiannopoulos, the British far-right provocateur with whom she fell out and for
whose removal [she long
called](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/08/28/us/politics/milo-yiannopoulos-
arrested-ice.html).

Compared to all that, what is Hasan Piker? A leftist streamer who has made
controversial statements, for example about 9/11, [which he walked
back](https://www.reuters.com/fact-check/hasan-piker-911-remark-misattributed-
michigans-el-sayed-2026-08-14/), and who has seen those and other statements,
for example about American Jews and Israel, and [not much
different](https://www.facebook.com/watch/?v=1044020545065599) than remarks by
Hannah Arendt, willfully and widely misrepresented. Piker [has
appeared](https://zeteo.com/p/abdul-el-sayed-hasan-piker-michigan-senate-
media) with Abdul El-Sayed, the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in
Michigan, who is now being forced by his own party to distance himself from
Piker and his views.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

If it's near-impossible to find a senior national journalist or indeed a
senior national Democrat saying anything about Loomer's abject racism about a
candidate for Senate, two congresswomen, a former congresswoman and the first
Black woman on the U.S. Supreme Court, it's also near impossible to find a
senior national journalist or a senior national Democrat not [rushing to
attack Piker, on social media or on
TV](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/30/politics/video/el-sayed-sotu-piker):

But here we are. The president has a close ally and adviser who has called
herself **"[ a proud Islamophobe](https://www.theguardian.com/us-
news/2023/aug/14/laura-loomer-trump-praise-white-supremacist),"** and who has
described Islam as a **" cancer on society"** and Muslims as **" savages."**
We get why no one wants to talk about that, and would rather attack a
prominent Muslim commentator and a prominent Muslim candidate, both of them
stringent critics of Israel.

But, to repeat, Loomer has now called five prominent Black women **" ghetto
Black bitches," **and repeated and varied the slur. Isn't that enough to stir
up some sort of comment or action? Anything?

[Bueller? Bueller? Bueller?](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f4zyjLyBp64)…
Loomer?

## **🇮 🇷 **Iran War Updates

  * **Strait strikes:** On Saturday, a tanker was [struck](https://apnews.com/article/mideast-iran-israel-palestinians-august-30-2026-49cf07bcd4f9166f93f51136892d76a6) in the Strait of Hormuz. On Sunday, U.S. forces hit Iranian rocket launchers on Larak Island in the first military action in a month, with AP [citing](https://apnews.com/article/iran-strait-hormuz-strike-united-states-6b098da673ac3161a266ee459d5eff44) an official who said Iranians were preparing to launch "rockets with sea mines." Iran [said](https://aje.news/xxqr90?update=4900847) fighters and civilians were killed and wounded, and promised to respond. U.S. forces in Jordan were [attacked](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/8/31/iran-war-live-irgc-attacks-us-bases-in-jordan-after-us-bombs-larak-islandhttps://aje.news/y2cyrh?update=4901416).

  * **Slop press:** Late Sunday, Trump [posted](https://truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump/posts/117187722429803464) to Truth Social AI videos and the message "Kharg Island being blown to smithereens!!! President DJT." Echoing George W. Bush, who attacked Iraq, he also posted video of his golf drive.

  * **Bombshell report:** The _Washington Post_ [reported](https://www.washingtonpost.com/national-security/2026/08/30/military-leaders-warn-hegseth-against-extending-iran-war-operations/) "several U.S. military leaders have advised Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth that prolonging large-scale operations against Iran is unsustainable and risks weakening their ability to confront threats elsewhere." Pentagon spokesperson Sean Parnell [called](https://x.com/SeanParnellASW/status/2094103560384389592?s=46) the report a "crime."

  * **Ayatollah speaks:** Iranian Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei [said](https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/irans-khamenei-urges-gulf-rulers-written-message-confront-real-enemy-2026-08-30/) Muslim nations should "know your real enemy, understand its plans and confront it."

  * **Family affair:** Yair Netanyahu, the son of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, was "evacuated" from his home in Miami due to a "significant threat" to his life, Israel's Shin Bet security agency [said](https://apnews.com/article/mideast-iran-israel-palestinians-august-30-2026-49cf07bcd4f9166f93f51136892d76a6). Benjamin Netanyahu, whose forces have killed Iranian leaders' family members, including Khamenei's father, previously said Iran had tried to kill one of his sons.

  * **Lebanon latest:** The U.S. State Department [said](https://x.com/usembassybeirut/status/2093766301340828099?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw%7Ctwcamp%5Etweetembed%7Ctwterm%5E2093766301340828099%7Ctwgr%5E32eeb359b4dffc5e54a7fec1039bcc29f553c2cd%7Ctwcon%5Es1_&ref_url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.i24news.tv%2Fen%2Fnews%2Fmiddle-east%2Flevant-turkey%2Fartc-washington-to-hezbollah-lay-down-your-arms-and-stop-taking-orders-from-iran) Iran-backed Hezbollah had to disarm before a peace process could be put into effect. Israel [continued](https://x.com/ThisIsBeirut_) to ignore the ceasefire, with artillery and airstrikes in the south of the country.

## 'Rebuke or Punishment'

[![](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!YidB!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-
post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F2c0e5096-81a7-42bd-
bb2c-cebd20c6bcec_6599x4399.jpeg)](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!YidB!,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-
post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F2c0e5096-81a7-42bd-
bb2c-cebd20c6bcec_6599x4399.jpeg)_Debate moderator Kristen Welker listens
during the second 2020 presidential campaign debate in Nashville, Tennessee,
on Oct. 22, 2020. Photo by Jim Bourg/Pool/Reuters._

In Wisconsin in June, NBC 'Meet the Press' host Kristen Welker
[struggled](https://zeteo.com/p/ranting-screaming-trump-walks-out) through a
disastrous interview with Donald Trump, then pleaded with him not to stand up
and walk out. Later, she said he'd agreed to sit down again.

So much for groveling. Sunday brought an outburst Welker's way that brought to
mind that [tweet](https://x.com/Cavalorn/status/654934442549620736?lang=en)
that gets [trotted out](http://yiannopoulos) once a week: "'I never thought
leopards would eat MY face,' sobs woman who voted for the Leopards Eating
People's Faces Party."

On Truth Social, Trump
[said](https://x.com/atrupar/status/2094057761122230418?s=46) Welker would be
"reported to the FCC for rebuke or punishment," for the heinous sin of… saying
Trump has of late achieved "some mixed results" in endorsing Republicans for
Congress.

Welker was clearly correct. For the U.S. House, Trump picks Rep. Andy Ogles
(Tennessee), Rep. Cory Mills and Catalina Lauf (Florida), and Amir Hassan
(Michigan) were beaten. [So
were](https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/elections/2026/08/26/trump-2026-primary-
gop-republican-endorsements-data/91445969007/) gubernatorial picks Mike
Lindell (Minnesota), Burt Jones (Georgia), Rep. Randy Feenstra (Iowa), Pamela
Evette (South Carolina), and Megan Degenfelder (Wisconsin).

Yes, Trump's [general record is
strong](https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/elections/2026/08/26/trump-2026-primary-
gop-republican-endorsements-data/91445969007/). But even the high-profile wins
he touted were not particularly comfortable. Last week, Trump dragged Lindsey
Graham's know-nothing sister, Darline, over the line in the South Carolina
Senate primary and saw Mike Mazzei squeak the nomination for governor in
Oklahoma.

Meaningful FCC "rebuke or punishment" for Welker is unlikely, however much
Trump squeals about his pet FCC Chair, Brendan Carr, taking "this threat to
our country very seriously."

But Trump's outburst did point to his very real threat to the press. As he
bleated [about](https://x.com/PollTracker2024/status/2094049917845016904)
"fake polls used by a crooked media," reporters from the _New York Times_ ,
the _Wall Street Journal_ , and Bloomberg were being barred from the G20
meeting in North Carolina, while the Pentagon
[claimed](https://x.com/SeanParnellASW/status/2094103560384389592?s=46) a
_Washington Post_ report of military warnings about extending the Iran war was
a criminal matter.

On Sunday, NBC said: "Kristen is one of the best in the business, and we stand
by her." It would have done better to call Trump out as the threat to free
speech that he is.

## **🗞 ️ **What You Need to Know

  * **Bizarre interview:** Speaking to GOP congressman turned Fox host Trey Gowdy, Trump talked Iran, the economy, and [dream (golf) foursomes](https://x.com/LucasSa56947288/status/2094243889498513622). He also confirmed he wants Republican voters to pretend he is on the ballot in November. Polling suggests that may be unwise.

  * **ICE horror:** Ten people [described](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/08/30/world/africa/us-deportation-flight-ice-detention-liberia.html) to the _New York Times_ brutal deportations to Liberia, where they have no ties. Five said they were beaten for protesting. "They didn't treat us like people, like human beings," said Carlos Tellez-Sanchez, from Venezuela. "They can say or do anything to you and there's nothing you can do." CBS further [reported](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/ice-deportations-afghanistan-cuba-africa/) the increase in such "third country" deportations.

  * **Deport in a storm:** Trump Border Czar Tom Homan [all but admitted](https://thehill.com/homenews/administration/6059702-homan-milo-yiannopoulos-deported/) far-right provocateur Milo Yiannopoulos was swiftly deported and publicly shamed because even-further-right activist Laura Loomer told authorities the Briton overstayed his visa. Homan denied Yiannopoulos was deliberately spared detention in tough conditions.

  * **Dem defers:** Veteran Rep. James Clyburn [told NBC](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/congress/jim-clyburn-impeaching-trump-shouldnt-democrats-priority-win-house-rcna595118) Democrats should not prioritize impeaching Trump if they take back the House. "Our priority ought to be making housing, education, energy, healthcare affordable and accessible for all of our citizens," he said. "Impeaching the president will not do that."

  * **Lying eyes:** Mike Rogers, the GOP Senate candidate in Michigan, [claimed](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/aug/29/michigan-senate-candidate-mike-rogers-osama-bin-laden) in a fundraising email to have seen "the dead body of Osama bin Laden with my own eyes." But in 2011, at the time of the raid that killed the al-Qaeda leader, Rogers, then chair of the House Intelligence Committee, told reporters he was informed of events the next day.

  * **Epstein news:** A Brazilian doctor whose wife [publicly linked](https://www.miamiherald.com/news/local/community/miami-dade/article315437390.html) Donald and Melania Trump to the late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein [fled Florida](https://www.miamiherald.com/news/local/crime/article317037243.html) days before he was due to go on trial for allegedly conducting cosmetic procedures without a license. Joao Araujo said he was "a fugitive now. With honor."

## 🌏 Anywhere But America

  * **🇵 🇸 Don't forget Gaza: **An Israeli strike [killed](https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-strike-kills-two-people-including-3-year-old-boy-gaza-medics-say-2026-08-30/) two Palestinians, including a 3-year-old boy, and wounded several yesterday, while an attack today [killed](https://aje.news/y2cyrh?update=4902368) at least two others. Jose Andres, head of World Central Kitchen, [addressed](https://x.com/chefjoseandres/status/2094029364132241429) the Israeli officer who [said](https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/israeli-officer-who-ordered-wck-strike-gaza-says-he-not-sorry) he wasn't sorry for directing the strike that killed seven of the aid group's workers in April 2024.   * Confronted with **Democratic Senator Chris Murphy 's** claim that ICE is "arresting parents at school bus stops" in Connecticut, leaving children "alone [and] scared to death," **Trump Border Czar Tom Homan** failed to issue any sort of denial.   * **Rep. Jim Clyburn of South Carolina** , 86 and in Congress 33 years, [told NBC's 'Meet the Press'](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/congress/jim-clyburn-impeaching-trump-shouldnt-democrats-priority-win-house-rcna595118) he regretted advocating for **Clarence Thomas** during his 1991 Supreme Court confirmation process. "I have made mistakes in my life, and that's one that I made, and I will own up to that mistake," Clyburn said, considering Thomas's far-right opinions and [alleged rampant corruption](https://theweek.com/in-depth/1022846/a-running-list-of-clarence-thomas-scandals).
